summary: Explore Seoul's rich history, vibrant culture, and trendy neighborhoods in a 10-day adventure covering major landmarks and popular districts.

pois.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace (경복궁)
pois.notes: The largest of the Five Grand Palaces and a symbol of Korea's royal heritage.

pois.name: National Folk Museum of Korea (국립민속박물관)
pois.notes: Experience Korean folk culture through exhibits and artifacts.

pois.name: Insadong (인사동)
pois.notes: Famous for traditional tea houses, antique shops, and art galleries.

pois.name: Sanchon (산촌)
pois.notes: Enjoy traditional Korean temple food in a serene setting.

pois.name: Jogyesa Temple (조계사)
pois.notes: The chief temple of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism.

pois.name: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (동대문디자인플라자)
pois.notes: An iconic landmark of modern architecture designed by Zaha Hadid.

pois.name: Myeongdong (명동)
pois.notes: A bustling shopping district known for cosmetics and fashion.

pois.name: Yoogane Myeongdong (유가네 명동)
pois.notes: Famous for delicious dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken).

pois.name: Seoul Namsan Tower (서울 남산타워)
pois.notes: Offers panoramic views of Seoul and is a popular date spot.

pois.name: SMTOWN coexartium (SM타운 코엑스아티움)
pois.notes: A must-visit for K-pop fans, featuring exhibits and merchandise.

pois.name: Changdeokgung Palace (창덕궁)
pois.notes: A UNESCO World Heritage site with a beautiful secret garden.

pois.name: Bukchon Hanok Village (북촌한옥마을)
pois.notes: Stroll through traditional Korean houses and experience historical architecture.

pois.name: Samcheongdong Sujebi (삼청동 수제비)
pois.notes: Famous for its handmade noodle soup, a Korean comfort food.

pois.name: Cheonggyecheon Stream (청계천)
pois.notes: A picturesque stream running through downtown Seoul, perfect for a relaxing walk.

pois.name: Dongdaemun Market (동대문시장)
pois.notes: A major market hub for wholesale and retail shopping.

pois.name: War Memorial of Korea (전쟁기념관)
pois.notes: Explore Korea's military history through extensive exhibits and outdoor displays.

pois.name: Itaewon (이태원)
pois.notes: A vibrant multicultural district known for its diverse dining and shopping options.

pois.name: Vatos Urban Tacos Itaewon (바토스 이태원)
pois.notes: Enjoy a fusion of Korean and Mexican flavors at this popular eatery.

pois.name: Namsan Park (남산공원)
pois.notes: A beautiful park surrounding Namsan Mountain, offering hiking trails and city views.

pois.name: Leeum, Samsung Museum of Art (리움 삼성미술관)
pois.notes: Features both traditional and contemporary Korean art in a stunning architectural setting.

pois.name: Hongdae (홍대)
pois.notes: A youthful district known for its indie music scene, street art, and vibrant nightlife.

pois.name: Trick Eye Museum (트릭아이미술관)
pois.notes: Interactive 3D art museum perfect for fun photos.

pois.name: Kyochon Chicken Hongdae (교촌치킨 홍대)
pois.notes: Savor some of Korea's best fried chicken at this popular chain.

pois.name: Hongdae Mural Street (홍대벽화거리)
pois.notes: Discover vibrant street art and murals in this creative neighborhood.

pois.name: KT&G Sangsangmadang Hongdae (KT&G 상상마당 홍대)
pois.notes: A cultural complex featuring a cinema, art gallery, and live music.

pois.name: Seongsu-dong Cafe Street (성수동 카페거리)
pois.notes: Explore unique cafes in this trendy, up-and-coming neighborhood.

pois.name: Seoul Forest (서울숲)
pois.notes: A large green space offering beautiful nature trails and recreational areas.

pois.name: Seongsu Handmade Shoe Street (성수동 수제화거리)
pois.notes: Find unique, handcrafted shoes in Seongsu's famous shoe district.

pois.name: Daelim Changgo Gallery (대림창고 갤러리)
pois.notes: Contemporary art gallery in a transformed warehouse space.

pois.name: Majang Meat Market (마장축산물시장)
pois.notes: Experience Seoul's largest meat market and try various Korean BBQ.

pois.name: COEX Mall (코엑스몰)
pois.notes: Asia's largest underground shopping mall, featuring shops, restaurants, and an aquarium.

pois.name: Bongeunsa Temple (봉은사)
pois.notes: A serene temple offering a glimpse into Korea's Buddhist traditions.

pois.name: Samwon Garden (삼원가든)
pois.notes: Enjoy premium Korean BBQ in a beautiful garden setting.

pois.name: Garosu-gil (가로수길)
pois.notes: A trendy street lined with cafes, restaurants, and boutique shops.

pois.name: Gangnam Style Statue (강남스타일 말춤 동상)
pois.notes: Snap a photo with the statue celebrating Psy's global hit.

pois.name: Lotte World (롯데월드)
pois.notes: One of the world's largest indoor amusement parks with thrilling rides and parades.

pois.name: Lotte World Tower (롯데월드타워)
pois.notes: Visit the observation deck for breathtaking views from Korea's tallest building.

pois.name: Seokchon Lake Park (석촌호수공원)
pois.notes: A beautiful lake park ideal for a relaxing walk, especially during cherry blossom season.

pois.name: Songpa Naru Park (송파나루공원)
pois.notes: A serene park adjacent to Lotte World, perfect for leisurely strolls.

pois.name: Jamsil Sausage Stew (잠실부대찌개)
pois.notes: Try Korea’s unique take on sausage stew (budae jjigae) at this local favorite.

pois.name: Seoul Arts Center (예술의 전당)
pois.notes: A cultural complex offering exhibitions, concerts, and performances.

pois.name: Hangang Park (한강공원)
pois.notes: Enjoy a leisurely bike ride or a picnic by the Han River.

pois.name: Mapo Galbi (마포갈비)
pois.notes: Indulge in delicious Korean BBQ at this renowned restaurant.

pois.name: Ewha Womans University (이화여자대학교)
pois.notes: Explore Korea’s largest women's university with its architecturally stunning campus.

pois.name: Dongjin Market (동진시장)
pois.notes: Visit this local market for a taste of authentic Korean street food and crafts.

pois.name: Gyeongui Line Forest Park (경의선숲길)
pois.notes: A linear park built on a disused railway track, offering a peaceful urban escape.

pois.name: Seoul Museum of History (서울역사박물관)
pois.notes: Delve into Seoul's past from the Joseon Dynasty to modern times.

pois.name: Tongin Market (통인시장)
pois.notes: Famous for its dosirak cafe, where you can create your own lunchbox with Korean dishes.

pois.name: Deoksugung Palace (덕수궁)
pois.notes: A beautiful palace with a unique mix of Western and Korean architectural styles.

pois.name: Mokdong Ice Rink (목동아이스링크)
pois.notes: End your trip with an ice-skating session in one of Seoul's popular rinks.
